HANDOFF STATE 2026-11-09 19:50 PST

Gerrit
- Change 3336, "Move the OpenAI CI arm to gpt-5.5". Patch set 1, revision e0c6912f21c365f5a3197dcec7748a25eb2b2afd. Status NEW, ready (WIP removed 18:54 PST after the coordinator's RELEASED).
- Votes: LLM-Review +1 (14:36 PST), Verified +1 (15:04 PST, GitHub run 42712884640), 0 unresolved comments. All 3 submit conditions are met. NOT yet submitted.

Worktree
- /Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.rebar/worktrees/fix-baboon, branch fix-baboon, HEAD e0c6912f21c (= patch set 1). No uncommitted changes.
- Scratch evidence (local only, git-ignored): .rebar/scratch/baboon-13725/ in that worktree. It holds the request-capture scripts, CI logs, usage-log artifacts, both make-verify logs and the plan-review logs.

Running
- A vote-polling loop, pid 88738 (shell, current child: sleep). It only reads Gerrit, every 2 min; output in the session task file bb2a7t9fy.output. Its stop condition has a bug (it requires the minimum Verified value to be 1, but a 0 entry exists), so it will not stop early. It ends on its own after 45 polls, around 20:24 PST. It changes nothing; leave it or ignore it.
- No make verify, gate op or GitHub dispatch run is running for this ticket.

Next steps, in order
1. Recheck change 3336's live votes and that the current revision is still e0c6912f21c365f5a3197dcec7748a25eb2b2afd, then land it with: scripts/gerrit_safe_submit.py 3336 --revision e0c6912f21c365f5a3197dcec7748a25eb2b2afd
2. Record the change number, both votes and the merged SHA on origin/main as a comment here.
3. Dispatch "Live External Integration" (workflow_dispatch, approved) on main after the merge: gh workflow run external-integration.yml --ref main. Record the run id.
4. If "external LLM (live openai)" concludes success with no invalid_prompt: record the run id and job conclusions here, tick the ACs, and close with class superseded (transition deceptive-banal-baboon in_progress closed --class superseded; this goes through the completion-verifier gate, about 10 min; never --force).
5. If gpt-5.5 is also rejected with invalid_prompt, use the fallback in this ticket's plan: a second Gerrit change that removes the openai matrix entry and the openai credential branch/env from .github/workflows/external-integration.yml, deletes .github/llm-providers/openai.toml, records the removal in docs/ci-provider-matrix.md, and in tests/unit/test_ci_provider_matrix.py removes test_the_openai_arm_is_live_ready_with_its_own_credential plus the openai entries in _PROVIDER_KEY_ENV and _MODEL_QUALIFIER_BY_PROVIDER. Run make verify with JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN unset before pushing, land at LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1 / 0 unresolved, dispatch again, record both run ids, close superseded.
- Push hashtag: rebar-session-a85e3cd3-9e61-4f25-9de4-cd740e853b4d. Use make amend-msg to reword a commit. Report times in PST.

Decided
- Root cause: OpenAI-side rejection of unchanged requests (evidence in the earlier comment). No rebar code defect, no retry added.
- The operator chose to switch to a newer model, with removing the arm as the fallback. gpt-5.5 was chosen from developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/all; GPT-6 needs pydantic-ai-slim 2.x, and gpt-5.6-* has a disputed profile.
- Close class: superseded.
- Plan review passed at 13:44 PST; the ticket is claimed (in_progress, joeoakhart@navapbc.com). make verify passed on the committed tree (14:32 PST).

Open
- It is not yet known whether OpenAI accepts the plan-review requests on gpt-5.5, or whether gpt-5.5 is enabled on the repo's account. The dispatch run in step 3 settles both.
- Not acted on: OpenAI's catalogue marks gpt-5.4-nano (the arm's trivial slot) as Deprecated.
